items.title: Exercise1.7: produce the actual smooth test's finite integrals

source.anchor: Exercise1.7/(1.E.1), printed43/PDF55; compact smooth function LSI, printed48/PDF60
source.attribution: Sinho Chewi's linearization exercise; original ASTIS derivation of an analytic prerequisite, not a printed standalone theorem or complete answer.

items.statement: The linearization route must produce finite analytic inputs for its actual noncompact square-root test, rather than adding them as exercise premises. For any finite measure on a real normed measurable space, a globally bounded C-infinity real f with compactly supported Frechet derivative has integrable squared derivative norm. For every sufficiently small real epsilon, the explicit sqrt(1+epsilon*f) is everywhere positive, genuinely C-infinity, L2 and has integrable entropy and actual derivative energy. Compact-test LSI admissibility and the final PI conclusion remain separate.
assumptions: The source exercise is Euclidean/probabilistic. This is a generic finite-measure intermediate theorem, not the final LSI-to-PI anchor.
The global pointwise bound is needed for global smoothness. The eventual source consumer must derive it and compact derivative support from its actual centered test.
C-infinity is retained; original/perturbed integrability is a conclusion, not a supplied source-domain certificate.

formulae.label: actual finite inputs
formulae.tex: u_\varepsilon=\sqrt{1+\varepsilon f}\in C^\infty\cap L^2(\mu),\quad u_\varepsilon^2\log(u_\varepsilon^2),\ \|Du_\varepsilon\|^2\in L^1(\mu).

obligations.label: Produce original squared-derivative integrability from the actual smooth compact-derivative class
Global positive smooth square root and actual finite L2/entropy/energy inputs
Derive the source class after centering, justify compact-test LSI extension/application, and close the PI/core conclusion

bindings.boundary: Only source-class analytic input production. No compact support of the square root, noncompact LSI extension, canonical KL/Fisher, PI/core closure, full exercise or Bench admission.

assumption_deltas.source: Smooth bounded compact-gradient tests under a Euclidean probability law.
assumption_deltas.lean: Any finite measure on a real normed space with measurable open sets, a globally bounded C-infinity real function and compactly supported Frechet derivative.
assumption_deltas.reason: A canonical analytic prerequisite only. The complete-Hilbert focused test explicitly adapts compact gradient support via Riesz and proves the gradient-energy consumer. Probability normalization, centering and the final exercise source class are not silently assumed or concluded.

assumption_deltas.source: A compact smooth LSI may be applied only to admissible tests; the square-root perturbation is generally noncompact.
assumption_deltas.lean: Genuine C-infinity, L2 and actual finite entropy/energy are derived, but no LSI-domain assertion appears.
assumption_deltas.reason: The separate cutoff/domain extension remains open. An a.e. bound from the generic parent is not mistaken for global positivity, and the smooth infinity order is not weakened to C2.
